name: anlide/hilos-demo-hilos-website
description: Official Hilos Framework website demo project

scripts.hilos-frontend-reminder: @php -r "echo PHP_EOL . 'Hilos frontend: run npm install in the frontend container after composer changes, so the vendored SDK is not stale - see framework/frontend/README.md.' . PHP_EOL;"
scripts.setup-env: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-frontend-cli-local sh -c "cd /hilos/demo/hilos-website && cp -n .env.example .env || true; ls -l .env"
scripts.install-deps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-cli-local composer install
scripts.daemon-status: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:status
scripts.daemon-monitor: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:monitor
scripts.cli: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php
scripts.db:migration:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:up
scripts.db:migration:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:down
scripts.db:migration:status: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:status
scripts.db:migration:retry: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:retry
scripts.db:seed:apply: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:seed:apply
scripts.db:schema:status: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:schema:status
scripts.frontend:install: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-frontend-cli-local npm install
scripts.frontend:check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-frontend-cli-local npm run check
scripts.frontend:lint: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-frontend-cli-local npm run lint
scripts.frontend:format-check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-frontend-cli-local npm run format:check
scripts.frontend:build: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-frontend-cli-local npm run build
scripts.test:install-deps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm --no-deps hilos-website-cli-test composer install --no-interaction
test:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm hilos-website-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:logs:reset
scripts.test:db-reset: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm hilos-website-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:db:reset
scripts.test:db-wait: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm hilos-website-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:wait
scripts.test:db-prepare: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm hilos-website-cli-test sh -c "php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:wait && php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:db:reset"
scripts.test:unit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm hilos-website-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite unit
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm hilos-website-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite integration
scripts.test:phpunit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --build --rm hilos-website-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml
scripts.test:check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm hilos-website-frontend-cli-test sh -c "set -e; node ../../../framework/frontend/scripts/npm-install-if-stale.mjs; echo '--- frontend: check'; npm run check; echo '--- frontend: lint'; npm run lint; echo '--- frontend: format-check'; npm run format:check"
